info.name: SPARQL 1.1 Protocol Query Sparql Graph API

params.name: graph
params.description: URI of the named graph to retrieve. If omitted, the default graph is returned.

params.name: default
params.description: Set to empty string to request the default graph

items.docs: Retrieves an RDF graph from the SPARQL Graph Store using HTTP GET. Part of the SPARQL 1.1 Graph Store HTTP Protocol for managing named graphs and the default graph.

info.name: SPARQL Merge into Graph (Graph Store Protocol)

params.name: graph
params.description: URI of the named graph to merge into

params.name: default
params.description: Set to empty string to target the default graph

items.docs: Merges the provided RDF data into the specified graph, adding triples without removing existing ones.

params.name: graph
params.description: URI of the named graph to replace

params.name: default
params.description: Set to empty string to target the default graph

items.docs: Replaces the contents of a graph with the provided RDF data. Creates the graph if it does not exist.

params.name: graph
params.description: URI of the named graph to delete

params.name: default
params.description: Set to empty string to clear the default graph

items.docs: Deletes a named graph or clears the default graph.
